description: Export plugin examples for textmode.js export workflows.

groups.name: ExportPlugin
groups.description: Plugin installation, overlay controls, export helpers, layer targets, and animation captures.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.init
examples.description: Installs ExportPlugin and demonstrates overlay show, hide, toggle, and visibility.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.overlayPosition
examples.description: Moves the export overlay with setPosition, reads getPosition, and restores placement with resetPosition.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.defaults
examples.description: Presets overlay formats and options with setDefaults, reads getDefaults, and restores curated values with resetDefaults.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.canvasStills
examples.description: Saves a PNG canvas image, creates a WebP image blob, and copies a canvas image to the clipboard.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.layerTargets
examples.description: Exports one chosen layer as text with toString and saveStrings.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.svgExport
examples.description: Exports a character landscape as an SVG using saveSVG and a vector font.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.jsonDocument
examples.description: Builds an all-layer JSON document with toJSON, measures toJSONString, and downloads with saveJSON.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.jsonSequence
examples.description: Captures a fixed-rate JSON sequence with toJSONSequenceBlob and saveJSONSequence.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.gifExport
examples.description: Records a looping GIF with toGIFBlob and saveGIF, including progress feedback.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.videoExport
examples.description: Records a short WebM clip with toVideoBlob and saveVideo, including progress feedback.

examples.title: ExportPlugin.zipSequence
examples.description: Packs PNG frames into a ZIP archive with toZipBlob and saveZip, including progress feedback.
